findings.summary: env singleton built at module import time defeats DI/fail-fast seam needed by wave-7 buildApp tests.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep loadEnv() factory; defer singleton to buildApp/main bootstrap or lazy-init via `let _env; export const getEnv = () => _env ??= loadEnv()`.

findings.summary: Subclass constructors repeat Object.setPrototypeOf already executed in AppError base ctor via new.target.prototype.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove trailing `Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);` from each subclass ctor (errors.ts L47, L57, L67, L77, L87, L97, L107).

findings.summary: pino redact wildcard `*.password` matches one nesting level only; deeper paths like req.body.user.password remain unredacted.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit deep paths to REDACT_PATHS (e.g. `req.body.user.password`) or document the depth limit. Add a redaction unit test in wave-7+.

findings.summary: PasswordHasher.verify(hash, plain) parameter order is non-conventional; many ecosystems use verify(plain, hash).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep current order (matches argon2 lib verify(digest, password)); ensure auth.service callers and test spies assert documented order. No code change.

findings.summary: UserId branded type duplicated across apps/api/shared/ids.ts and packages/contracts/src/auth.ts (zod brand) without a shared bridge.
findings.suggested_fix: Document in conventions or have shared/ids re-export the zod-branded UserId from @medbridge/contracts so callers use one canonical type.

findings.summary: logger imports `{ env }` singleton at module load, transitively forcing env validation before any DI seam can substitute LOG_LEVEL.
findings.suggested_fix: Once F-001's getEnv() seam lands, switch to `level: getEnv().LOG_LEVEL` in a logger factory, or accept LOG_LEVEL via buildLogger(opts) so buildApp wires it.
